A''' Beast Rider''' accompanied [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gobee]] as he searched the tunnels under the [[Iziz Royal Palace|Royal Palace]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and only [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Together with Gobee, this Beast Rider was present in the tunnels when [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] of Onderon revealed himself, an existence that was only rumored to be true by the city-dwelling citizens of Iziz. Pursued by Ommin's [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Naddist army|army]], this Beast Rider and Gobee fled the tunnels to warn their fellow Riders, along with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who were present on Onderon at the time, that the [[Naddist|worshippers]] of [[Freedon Nadd]] were coming to engage them [[Funeral of Amanoa|in battle]].
